Respectful, flattering, public-appearance image only: no paparazzi, private moments, children or gossip context. Crop to landscape 3:2 or 4:5 within the licence's cropping terms. Source: Editorial agency (for example Getty Images Editorial, Shutterstock Editorial, AP or PA Images) licensed by the team for web editorial use, credit as the agency requires. License from an editorial agency before use; never AI for a real person.
slots.note: License from an editorial agency before use; never AI for a real person.
